notes: Status field: live=implemented+tested, stub=defined no handler, partial=handler incomplete, missing=not yet built
uim_exposable: capability is safe and meaningful to expose to external UIM agents
auth_for_uim: recommended auth method when called via UIM protocol

capabilities.name: Create Network
capabilities.description: Register a new Solar-powered network specification with capabilities and energy source

capabilities.name: Query Network
capabilities.description: Retrieve network specification, metrics, and member list

capabilities.name: Update Network
capabilities.description: Update network name, capabilities, or status
capabilities.note: No executor handler — action defined but not implemented

capabilities.name: Delete Network
capabilities.description: Permanently delete a network specification

capabilities.name: Create Member
capabilities.description: Register a new TC-S Network member with optional Solar grant (max 10 Solar)

capabilities.name: Query Member
capabilities.description: Look up member profile, balance, and transaction history

capabilities.name: Suspend Member
capabilities.description: Temporarily or indefinitely suspend a member account

capabilities.name: Update Member
capabilities.description: Update member email, full name, or preferences

capabilities.name: Query Solar Balance
capabilities.description: Query Solar balance for a member or agent wallet

capabilities.name: Calculate Energy / Solar Conversion
capabilities.description: Convert between kWh and Solar using the 4,913 kWh/Solar constant

capabilities.name: Transfer Solar
capabilities.description: Transfer Solar between two members atomically via governed pipeline. Idempotency-protected, double-entry ledgered.
capabilities.audit_behavior: marketplace_ledger double-entry + transactions table debit+credit rows
capabilities.idempotency: idempotency_key embedded in transaction note field

capabilities.name: Mint Solar
capabilities.description: Mint new Solar backed by verified energy generation (kWhVerified ≥ amount × 4,913)
capabilities.note: Policy enforced; no executor handler; audit reference required

capabilities.name: Audit Transaction
capabilities.description: Deterministically verify a completed transaction: debit/credit balance, ledger double-entry, fee math, ownership record, duplicate detection. No LLM.

capabilities.name: Purchase Artifact
capabilities.description: Governed artifact purchase lifecycle: validate buyer/seller/listing, calculate fees (5% foundation), debit buyer, credit seller, create ownership record — all atomically.
capabilities.audit_behavior: marketplace_ledger triple-entry (debit buyer, credit seller, credit foundation) + artifact_copies ownership record
capabilities.atomicity: DB transaction (BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK) — failure rolls back all sides
capabilities.idempotency: checks artifact_copies for existing buyer+item pair; optional idempotency_key in metadata

capabilities.name: Query Marketplace
capabilities.description: Search active marketplace artifacts by query text and category; limit ≤ 100

capabilities.name: Create Asset
capabilities.description: Create a new marketplace asset record (not yet listed)

capabilities.name: Enrich Asset
capabilities.description: AI-enrich asset with metadata, category, brand, kWh footprint, carbon, risk, comparables

capabilities.name: List Asset
capabilities.description: Activate an asset listing on the marketplace

capabilities.name: Unlist Asset
capabilities.description: Remove an asset from the marketplace listing

capabilities.name: Price Quote
capabilities.description: Get AI-powered pricing recommendation with fee breakdown, confidence, and comparables

capabilities.name: Create Order
capabilities.description: Initiate a marketplace purchase order

capabilities.name: Generate Report
capabilities.description: Generate analytics reports across energy, transactions, members, marketplace, or compliance

capabilities.name: Log Ethics Event
capabilities.description: Record an ethics event for the UIM protocol with optional ethics score (0–100)
capabilities.uim_annotation: explicitly annotated for UIM protocol in api-surface.js

capabilities.name: Abundance Lens
capabilities.description: Get UIM abundance metric and LifeLens analysis for an artifact via SAi UIM Layer

capabilities.name: UIM Handshake Document
capabilities.description: Machine-readable UIM protocol handshake and capability declaration

capabilities.name: Generate 3D Artifact
capabilities.description: Generate a parametric STL artifact from a registered template with Solar pricing

capabilities.name: Mint 3D Artifact to Marketplace
capabilities.description: Generate STL and simultaneously list it as a purchasable marketplace item

capabilities.name: Register Factory Printer
capabilities.description: Register a physical 3D printer into the factory network
capabilities.auth_gap: UNPROTECTED — no auth currently required on registration

capabilities.name: Submit Print Job
capabilities.description: Submit a 3D artifact to the factory queue; assigns to least-busy idle printer; generates pickup code

capabilities.name: Factory Queue Status
capabilities.description: View current print queue, optionally filtered by event or printer

capabilities.name: Artifact Pickup
capabilities.description: Lookup and complete a physical artifact pickup by 6-character pickup code

capabilities.name: Kid Solar Chat
capabilities.description: Conversational AI agent with function calling, vision, and platform-aware context
capabilities.note: Personalized platform assistant — not suitable for generic UIM exposure

capabilities.name: Voice Assistant
capabilities.description: Voice input (transcription) + TTS response using OpenAI models

capabilities.name: LifeLens Artifact Analysis
capabilities.description: Human-needs mapping and energy insights for a marketplace artifact

capabilities.name: Product Search (Perplexity)
capabilities.description: Web-grounded product search with citations via Perplexity

capabilities.name: Commissioning Capability Manifest
capabilities.description: Machine-readable manifest of commissioning agent capabilities, allowed actions, regions, energy sources

capabilities.name: Scheduler Status
capabilities.description: View scheduler job status and next-run times

capabilities.name: UIM Capability Discovery
capabilities.description: Machine-readable capability registry endpoint for UIM agent discovery

capabilities.name: UIM Standardized Action Invocation
capabilities.description: Single standardized entry point for external UIM agents to invoke any exposed capability. Rate-limited. Circuit-breaker protected.

capabilities.name: UIM Async Callback / Webhook
capabilities.description: Webhook delivery for async capability results (approval-gated actions, long-running jobs)
capabilities.note: Approval-gated actions (medium/high/critical) complete asynchronously. UIM callers need a callback URL or polling endpoint.

capabilities.name: UIM External Agent Registry Entry
capabilities.description: Formal registration of the TC-S Network platform as a UIM agent/provider
capabilities.note: uim_handshakes table exists but no platform self-registration logic
